property_summary: For every bytes32 assertionId, C.getAssertionPolicy(assertionId).arbitrateViaEscalationManager is false; the mutant flips that field to true for some assertionId values, so there exist assertionId where the mutant returns true and thus violates the rule.
change_summary: Change arbitrateViaEscalationManager from false to true so the returned AssertionPolicy has arbitrateViaEscalationManager = true.
